definitions.explanation: A person's professional and educational background, including past jobs, positions held, and accomplishments. Used in formal contexts like job applications and introductions.

examples.japanese: {経歴|けいれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me about your career background.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧な{経歴|けいれき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
examples.english: He has an impressive career background.

examples.japanese: ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{職歴|しょくれき}→職歴：17959_shokureki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧{経歴|けいれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: You fill in your personal history, including education and work experience, on a resume.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word commonly seen on resumes and in professional introductions. Often broken down into ⟦{学歴|がくれき}→学歴：02628_gakureki⟧ (educational background) and ⟦{職歴|しょくれき}→職歴：17959_shokureki⟧ (work history) on Japanese resumes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経歴|けいれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧: to introduce one's background
- {経歴|けいれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詐称|さしょう}する→詐称する：25601_sashousuru⟧: to falsify one's credentials
- ⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧な{経歴|けいれき}: an impressive career
- {経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}: curriculum vitae

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{履歴|りれき}→履歴：09334_rireki⟧ refers more broadly to any record or history (including computer history), while {経歴|けいれき} specifically focuses on a person's career and life background.
